psychological_meaning: Black Forest evokes feelings of mystery, depth, and connection to nature. It represents a sense of grounding and stability, often associated with the earth and natural environments. This color promotes introspection and can symbolize resilience and quiet strength, reflecting the dense, untouched forests it is named after.
